chunks: Jamil narrated from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام that he said:

There is no harm in a woman praying beside a man while he is praying. Indeed, the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to pray while 'A'ishah was lying down in front of him and she was menstruating; when he wanted to prostrate, he would press her legs, so she would raise her legs until he prostrated.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a woman to pray beside a man during salat?
ai.summary: This hadith states that there is no problem with a woman praying beside a man while he is engaged in salat. It supports this ruling by citing the practice of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, showing that the presence of a menstruating woman near the place of prayer does not itself prevent the validity of prayer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.748 - Jamil narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) in which He said:

"There is no harm if a woman prays beside a man while he is praying. Indeed, The Prophet (sw) would pray while Aisha was lying down in front of him, even though She was menstruating. When he wanted to prostrate, he would touch her legs, and She would move them so that he could prostrate."
